homepage.q: Will accessory installations void my new car warranty?
homepage.a: No. We strictly follow OEM coupler-to-coupler fitment with zero wire cutting or slicing. All electronic accessories are connected via dedicated plug-and-play harnesses with individual inline fuses, preserving your manufacturer electrical warranty.

homepage.q: How long does a typical installation take?
homepage.a: Minor upgrades (fog lamps, floor mats, dashcams) take 1 to 2 hours. Full customization packages (ambient lighting, Android infotainment, 360° camera, custom seat covers) typically require 4 to 6 hours for meticulous calibration.

homepage.q: Do you offer custom bucket fit seat covers for all car models?
homepage.a: Yes. We manufacture and stitch custom-fit seat covers tailored to the exact seat contour and airbag specifications of every car model, available in perforated Nappa leather, premium PU, and microfiber finishes.

homepage.q: Where is your showroom located in Chennai?
homepage.a: Our workshop and showroom is at Palani Murugan Building, No: 21, Westcott Rd, next to Woodlands Theater, Royapettah, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600014. We have dedicated bay parking for customer car fitment.

homepage.q: How do I get a quote or book a fitment slot?
homepage.a: You can click "Get a Quote" or message us on WhatsApp with your vehicle model and required accessories. Our technicians will share detailed upgrade options and confirm an installation slot.

about.q: How long has Best Car Accessories been operating?
about.a: We have been serving car owners in Chennai for over 15 years from our studio.

about.q: What types of accessories do you offer?
about.a: We offer a comprehensive range of exterior and interior car accessories including lighting, infotainment, cameras, audio, seat covers, floor mats, ambient lighting, and complete interior customization.
We are located at Palani Murugan Building, No: 21, Westcott Rd, next to Woodlands Theater, Royapettah, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600014.

about.q: How can I enquire about a specific accessory?
about.a: You can call us, WhatsApp us, or use the contact form on our website. Please include your car model and the accessories you are interested in.

exterior.q: Can exterior accessories be installed on any car?
exterior.a: Most accessories are available for a wide range of car models. Compatibility is checked before installation. Some items are vehicle-specific.

exterior.q: Do you handle all wiring without cutting factory wires?
exterior.a: Yes. All electrical accessories are installed with proper OEM relays, couplers, fuses, and clean heat-shrink wiring to protect warranty.

exterior.q: Can I enquire about an accessory before visiting?
exterior.a: Yes. WhatsApp your car model and the accessory you are interested in, and we will get back to you with availability and options.

exterior.q: How long does exterior accessory installation take?
exterior.a: Installation time varies depending on the accessory (1 to 3 hours typical). Contact us with your requirements for an exact time estimate.

exterior.q: Do you offer aftercare and fitment checks?
exterior.a: Yes. Every vehicle fitment is inspected and tested thoroughly before handover, and our team is always on standby for adjustments.

interior.q: Can interior accessories be added to any car?
interior.a: Most interior accessories are engineered with vehicle-specific frames and harnesses. We verify exact compatibility before recommending upgrades.

interior.q: Do you offer bespoke custom seat cover stitching?
interior.a: Yes. We provide bespoke tailoring with custom colour accents, diamond or honeycomb quilting, perforation, and OEM bucket styling.

interior.q: Will infotainment upgrades void my car's factory warranty?
interior.a: No. All our touchscreen infotainment systems use 100% plug-and-play vehicle-specific wiring couplers with zero wire cutting.
Our symphony ambient lighting kits run through factory concealed channels, controlled seamlessly via smartphone app or dashboard controls with 64+ colors and rhythm modes.

interior.q: Can I get a sound damping and audio upgrade together?
interior.a: Yes, multi-layer acoustic door damping combined with component speakers significantly eliminates road noise and elevates bass punch.
